Class OrderStatusStreamRegistry

java.lang.Object
app.order.event.OrderStatusStreamRegistry
@Component public class OrderStatusStreamRegistry extends Object
The open order-status streams, one list of server-sent event emitters per signed-in user. OrderStatusStreamController adds a connection when a client opens GET /api/orders/stream; OrderStatusPusherListener sends each committed status change to the owner's connections (BR-07).

Nothing is stored. A user with no open connection receives nothing, and reconnecting clients read the order list to catch up. A connection that fails on send is dropped; the servlet container's completion, timeout and error callbacks remove the rest. A heartbeat every app.events.stream.heartbeat-millis keeps idle connections alive through proxies.

      public int push(UUID userId, String payloadJson)
      Sends one order status change to every open connection of its owner.
